# Three Dividend-paying Space Investments Offer Alternatives to SpaceX


By:[Paul Dykewicz](https://www.dividendinvestor.com/author/pdykewicz-admin/)


, October 2, 2026


Link copied!


Three dividend-paying[space investments](https://www.stockinvestor.com/three-space-stocks-to-watch-for-liftoff/) offer alternatives to SpaceX (NASDAQ: SPCX), the world’s largest pure-play provider of launch services, its global Starlink broadband service and much more.


One reason to consider alternatives to SpaceX, of Starbase, Texas, is that the company’s shares are vulnerable to dips as company insiders start to gain the opportunity sell the stock they have accumulated for years. Unlike some companies that go[public](https://www.stockinvestor.com/three-stocks-expected-to-benefit-from-spacex-going-public/) and set a lockout period of a certain time period, such as 90 or 180 days, SpaceX has nine different dates that allow separate groups of shareholders to sell their shares.


The value of that strategy is that it is designed to prevent the shares from plunging on a single trading day if all the insiders were allowed to sell their shares at the same time. Instead,[SpaceX](https://www.stockinvestor.com/three-stocks-expected-to-benefit-from-spacex-going-public/) is taking a staggered approach with many lockup periods to spread out the selling and allow the share price to adjust.


**Three Dividend-paying Space Investments Offer Alternatives: Signal System**


One Wall Street veteran who recently discussed the lockup situation with SpaceX is Bryan Perry, who heads the[Cash Machine](https://www.bryanperryinvesting.com/offer/cash-default/?source=GURUCASH1) investment newsletter that features a portfolio of income-paying investments that average an annual[dividend yield](https://www.dividendinvestor.com/two-dividend-paying-space-investments-on-the-rise/) of more than 10%. Perry also leads advisory services that feature both stocks and options that he recommends with a goal of producing profits faster and larger than the steady income-paying investments recommended in his investment newsletter.


SpaceX completed the world’s largest initial public offering (IPO) on Friday, June 12, when it raised a record $75 billion at a price of $135 per share. Even though SpaceX now is listed on NASDAQ, many insiders still have not been able to share any of their shares.


For investors who want to know when to buy and sell SpaceX shares to avoid missteps, Perry recently told listeners of a teleforum that he has a system to provide such signals. He acknowledged that insiders selling their shares could adversely affect the stock’s value, but he offered a solution.


*Bryan Perry leads the[Hi-Tech Trader](https://www.bryanperryinvesting.com/offer/htt-default/?source=GURUHTT1) service.*


**Three Dividend-paying Space Investments Offer Alternatives: Powerful Plan**


Perry discussed his “powerful,” artificial intelligence (AI) trading plan that informs him of the “optimal time” to buy and sell the shares. The system has led investors to profits of 79%, 108%, 176% and even 304% in as little as seven days, he added.


It does so by sorting through more than 3,600 stocks to find the “best of the best,” Perry opined. Then, it ranks them from 0-100 as the best chance to rise over the next 22 days.


Advertisement.


“We only invest in those that have a score of 90 or higher,” Perry said.


The plan is used in his[Hi-Tech Trader](https://www.bryanperryinvesting.com/offer/htt-default/?source=GURUHTT1) advisory service that is distributed once a week, with occasional special alerts to advise the buy or sell of his recommendations.


“All my subscribers have to do is watch for my alerts,” Perry said during his teleforum. “When a stock is on the rise, I let them know immediately how to play it, including a corresponding option.”


**Three Dividend-paying Space Investments Offer Alternatives: SHLD**


One way to invest in a broad range of companies with exposure to space and defense is through an exchange-traded fund, Global X Defense Tech ETF (SHLD), said Michelle Connell, founder and chief investment officer with Dallas-based[Portia Capital Management](https://www.portia-capital-management.com/) . The ETF provides investors global exposure to the space industry through some of the largest defense and aerospace companies.


*Michelle Connell founded and heads[Portia Capital Management](https://www.portia-capital-management.com/) .*


Several of these names provide substantial exposure to the space industry, as well as aerospace and defense. They include the following:


L3Harris Technologies, Inc. (NYSE: LHX), a major American defense contractor, technology company and information technology (IT) services provider headquartered in Melbourne, Florida. The company generates 35% of its revenues from its space business.


Northrop Grumman Corp. (NYSE: NOC), of Falls Church, Virginia, produces 25% of its revenues from the company’s space system unit. NOC builds rocket boosters for NASA’s space launch system, as well as provides abort motors for the Orion spacecraft. In addition to manufacturing spacecraft, hardware and satellites, it also provides services to satellites.


Lockheed Martin Corp. (NYSE: LMT), of North Bethesda, Maryland, collects 19% of its revenues from the company’s space system unit. LMT builds solid rocket boosters for the space launch system through its NASA Artemis Program. It also develops enhanced protected tactical satellite communications through its U.S. space force program.


RTX Corp. (NYSE: RTX), of Arlington, Virginia, reported that 10% of company revenues are from its space system unit. The aerospace and defense giant manufactures small satellites, as well as support systems for NASA. In addition, RTX builds space based command and control networks.

SHLD, which offers a dividend yield of 0.70%, has been a profitable recommendation in the past from Jim Woods, a former U.S. Army officer and paratrooper who follows defense and space stocks and funds especially closely. Woods leads the *[Forecasts & Strategies](https://jimwoodsinvesting.stockinvestor.com/offer/fs-web-default-2/?source=GURUFS)* investment newsletter and the[Tactical Trader](https://jimwoodsinvesting.stockinvestor.com/offer/tactical-trader-web-default-offer/?source=GURUTT01) trading service that recommends stocks and options.

**Three Dividend-paying Space Investments Offer Alternatives: LHX**


L3Harris Technologies, Inc. manufactures several items used in the NASA Artemis program. LHX also provides power needs and instrumentation for deep space programs, including the Mars Rover. The company further builds hardware and power systems for private ventures.


Another L3Harris space business is its next generation of advanced sensors and imaging technology — orbiting on geostationary (GEO) satellites. The unit is designed to prepare people for severe weather and to warn them about it.


LHX also has a global radar systems engineering business that builds upon decades of success in serving the U.S. Space Surveillance Network (SSN) and the Space Superiority mission, delivering next-generation radar solutions for efficient, effective space battle management and command and control (C2).


*Chart courtesy of[www.stockcharts.com](http://www.stockcharts.com/) .*


**Three Space Stocks to Watch for Liftoff: IRDM**


One of the world’s most senior companies operating in low-Earth orbit (LEO) is McLean-Virginia-based Iridium Communications Inc. (NASDAQ: IRDM). Its constellation of 66 LEO satellites operate approximately 780 kilometers, or 485 miles, above the Earth, providing stronger signals and faster connections through smaller antennas with lower power requirements than spacecraft in geostationary orbit. The unique LEO structure of Iridium allows its satellite coverage to converge at the poles, ensuring coverage in the remote high-latitude regions that other satellite providers may not be able to serve.


[Rocket Lab](https://rocketlabcorp.com/) (NASDAQ: RKLB) recently received approval for the shareholders of[Iridium Communications](https://www.iridium.com/) to acquire the LEO operator for an enterprise value of approximately $8.0 billion, or $54.00 per share in cash and stock. I personally own shares of Iridium, partly due to its dividend payouts.


The deal is expected to close by mid-2027, so owning shares in Iridium offer ways to be paid through dividends if one stays patient. Shareholders also may be rewarded further if Rocket Lab and its businesses do well between now and mid-2027 to raise the value of the acquiring company.


*Chart courtesy of[www.stockcharts.com](http://www.stockcharts.com/) .*


**Three Dividend-paying Space Investments Offer Alternatives:** **Geopolitical Risk**

Russia is ramping up its invasion in Ukraine and strikes against civilian targets, despite recent visits to both nations’ capitals by President Trump’s envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, who sought to broker a peace agreement.


With increased military action taking place there, the Middle East and elsewhere, the three dividend-paying space investments offer a potentially profitable path to receive share-price appreciation and income.


Investors who are willing to trade options can try an advisory service that teaches how to do so. A pure-play options service that trades into volatility to pursue quick profits is the[DayTradeSPY](https://daytradespy.com/offer/trading-room-default-editorial/?source=GURUTR1) Trading Room, advised Hugh Grossman, who heads the service with his partner Jon Johnson. In fact, the[DayTradeSPY Trading Room](https://daytradespy.com/offer/trading-room-default-editorial/?source=GURUTR1) has a win rate that averages 89.8%, its[Pick of the Day](https://daytradespy.com/offer/pick-of-the-day-default/?source=GURUPOD1) service track record is 88.6% and the[DayTradeSPY Signal](https://daytradespy.com/offer/daytradespy-signal-default/?source=DTSSIGGURU) service produces profits 86% of the time.


As long as there is turmoil in the world… wars, tariffs, political upheaval, you name it, “we make money,” said Grossman, who also offers[Inner Circle](https://daytradespy.com/offer/inner-circle-default/?source=GURUIC1) memberships that include all his services.


“We can’t control the events of the day, but we can take advantage of that instability by trading short-term movements,” Grossman commented. “Options on SPY provide outstanding leverage and liquidity for quick profits.”
